title: 橢圓偏光儀建置
summary: 以反射偏振比 ρ = tanΨ·e^{iΔ} 為核心，說明橢圓偏光儀為何能把薄膜厚度量到次埃，再逐步建置光源、偏光鏡、補償器、測角儀與旋轉檢偏鏡，並用 SiO₂/Si 參考片把校正、參數相關性、視窗雙折射與量規重複性整合成可交接的儀器。
summaryEn: Built around the reflection polarization ratio ρ = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}, this course explains why an ellipsometer resolves film thickness to sub-ångström level, then assembles source, polarizer, compensator, goniometer and rotating analyzer step by step, using SiO₂/Si reference wafers to tie calibration, parameter correlation, window birefringence and gauge repeatability into a hand-over-ready instrument.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「橢偏量測的物理量與系統邊界」與「菲涅耳係數、薄膜干涉與厚度靈敏度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ellipsometric observables and system boundaries" and "Fresnel coefficients, thin-film interference and thickness sensitivity": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 橢偏量測的物理量與系統邊界：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Ellipsometric observables and system boundaries: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「反射偏振比 ρ 與入射角」如何決定橢圓偏光儀建置的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reflection ratio ρ and angle of incidence” determines the key performance of “Ellipsometer construction”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 橢圓偏光儀不量反射率的絕對值，而是量 p 偏振與 s 偏振反射係數的複數比 ρ = r_p/r_s = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}：Ψ 描述振幅比、Δ 描述相位差。因為是比值，光源強度漂移、偵測器增益變化與視窗穿透率都在第一階消去，這是它能把薄膜厚度解析到 0.01 nm 等級的根本原因。入射角選在基板布魯斯特角附近時 r_p 最小而 ρ 對薄膜最敏感；對矽（633 nm 時 n ≈ 3.88）布魯斯特角約 75.5°，所以商用儀器多在 65–75° 工作。系統邊界是：一束已知偏振的準直光、一個角度已知的反射面、一個能解出偏振態的分析臂。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反射偏振比 ρ 與入射角」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An ellipsometer does not measure absolute reflectance but the complex ratio of the p- and s-polarized reflection coefficients, ρ = r_p/r_s = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}, where Ψ describes the amplitude ratio and Δ the phase difference. Because it is a ratio, source drift, detector gain changes and window transmission cancel to first order, which is the root reason the technique resolves film thickness at the 0.01 nm level. Choosing the angle of incidence near the substrate's Brewster angle minimises r_p and maximises the sensitivity of ρ to a film; for silicon (n ≈ 3.88 at 633 nm) the Brewster angle is about 75.5°, so commercial instruments work at 65–75°. The system boundary is a collimated beam of known polarization, a reflecting surface at a known angle, and an analysis arm able to solve for the polarization state. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reflection ratio ρ and angle of incidence”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：裸基板可直接反演：⟨ε⟩ = sin²φ·[1 + tan²φ·((1 − ρ)/(1 + ρ))²]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A bare substrate inverts directly: ⟨ε⟩ = sin²φ·[1 + tan²φ·((1 − ρ)/(1 + ρ))²].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橢偏儀量的是反射光強度，所以光源越穩定厚度越準。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An ellipsometer measures reflected intensity, so a more stable source gives more accurate thickness." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「反射偏振比 ρ 與入射角」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Reflection ratio ρ and angle of incidence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 橢偏量測的物理量與系統邊界
knowledge.text: 橢圓偏光儀不量反射率的絕對值，而是量 p 偏振與 s 偏振反射係數的複數比 ρ = r_p/r_s = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}：Ψ 描述振幅比、Δ 描述相位差。因為是比值，光源強度漂移、偵測器增益變化與視窗穿透率都在第一階消去，這是它能把薄膜厚度解析到 0.01 nm 等級的根本原因。
knowledge.textEn: An ellipsometer does not measure absolute reflectance but the complex ratio of the p- and s-polarized reflection coefficients, ρ = r_p/r_s = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}, where Ψ describes the amplitude ratio and Δ the phase difference. Because it is a ratio, source drift, detector gain changes and window transmission cancel to first order, which is the root reason the technique resolves film thickness at the 0.01 nm level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橢偏儀量的是反射光強度，所以光源越穩定厚度越準。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An ellipsometer measures reflected intensity, so a more stable source gives more accurate thickness. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「橢偏量測的物理量與系統邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ellipsometric observables and system boundaries" is correct?
options: 橢偏儀量的是反射光強度，所以光源越穩定厚度越準。
橢圓偏光儀不量反射率的絕對值，而是量 p 偏振與 s 偏振反射係數的複數比 ρ = r_p/r_s = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}：Ψ 描述振幅比、Δ 描述相位差。
Ψ 與 Δ 和厚度是一一對應的，所以一個波長就能唯一決定厚度。
optionsEn: An ellipsometer measures reflected intensity, so a more stable source gives more accurate thickness.

An ellipsometer does not measure absolute reflectance but the complex ratio of the p- and s-polarized reflection coefficients, ρ = r_p/r_s = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}, where Ψ describes the amplitude ratio and Δ the phase difference.
Ψ and Δ map one-to-one to thickness, so a single wavelength determines it uniquely.
quiz.explanation: 橢圓偏光儀不量反射率的絕對值，而是量 p 偏振與 s 偏振反射係數的複數比 ρ = r_p/r_s = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}：Ψ 描述振幅比、Δ 描述相位差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An ellipsometer does not measure absolute reflectance but the complex ratio of the p- and s-polarized reflection coefficients, ρ = r_p/r_s = tanΨ·e^{iΔ}, where Ψ describes the amplitude ratio and Δ the phase difference. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 橢偏量測的物理量與系統邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ellipsometric observables and system boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反射偏振比 ρ 與入射角」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reflection ratio ρ and angle of incidence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：裸基板可直接反演：⟨ε⟩ = sin²φ·[1 + tan²φ·((1 − ρ)/(1 + ρ))²]。在 φ = 70°、632.8 nm 下量到 Ψ = 10.57°、Δ = 179.23°，代入得 ⟨ε⟩ = 15.07 − 0.148i，開根號得 n = 3.882、k = 0.019，正是矽在此波長的光學常數；布魯斯特角 arctan(3.882) = 75.5°。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A bare substrate inverts directly: ⟨ε⟩ = sin²φ·[1 + tan²φ·((1 − ρ)/(1 + ρ))²]. Measuring Ψ = 10.57° and Δ = 179.23° at φ = 70° and 632.8 nm gives ⟨ε⟩ = 15.07 − 0.148i, whose square root is n = 3.882, k = 0.019, the optical constants of silicon at that wavelength; the Brewster angle is arctan(3.882) = 75.5°. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用一片剛去除原生氧化層的矽片（或以已知 1.5–2 nm 原生氧化層建模）在 60°、65°、70°、75° 四個角度量 Ψ、Δ，各自反演出 ⟨ε⟩；若四組 n、k 一致到小數第二位，表示入射角、偏光鏡方位與偵測器線性都正確，否則角度相依的差異會直接指出哪個元件有系統誤差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure Ψ and Δ on a silicon wafer with its native oxide freshly removed (or modelled as a known 1.5–2 nm layer) at 60°, 65°, 70° and 75° and invert each to ⟨ε⟩; if the four n, k pairs agree to the second decimal, angle of incidence, polarizer azimuth and detector linearity are all correct, otherwise the angle-dependent discrepancy points directly at the element carrying a systematic error.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 裸基板可直接反演：⟨ε⟩ = sin²φ·[1 + tan²φ·((1 − ρ)/(1 + ρ))²]。在 φ = 70°、632.8 nm 下量到 Ψ = 10.57°、Δ = 179.23°，代入得 ⟨ε⟩ = 15.07 − 0.148i，開根號得 n = 3.882、k = 0.019，正是矽在此波長的光學常數；布魯斯特角 arctan(3.882) = 75.5°。
knowledge.textEn: A bare substrate inverts directly: ⟨ε⟩ = sin²φ·[1 + tan²φ·((1 − ρ)/(1 + ρ))²]. Measuring Ψ = 10.57° and Δ = 179.23° at φ = 70° and 632.8 nm gives ⟨ε⟩ = 15.07 − 0.148i, whose square root is n = 3.882, k = 0.019, the optical constants of silicon at that wavelength; the Brewster angle is arctan(3.882) = 75.5°.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「橢偏量測的物理量與系統邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ellipsometric observables and system boundaries", which statement holds?
options: 只要偵測器看得到光，樣品高度與傾斜就不會影響 Ψ、Δ。
MSE 越小的擬合結果一定越接近真實的薄膜參數。
裸基板可直接反演：⟨ε⟩ = sin²φ·[1 + tan²φ·((1 − ρ)/(1 + ρ))²]。
optionsEn: As long as the detector sees light, sample height and tilt do not affect Ψ and Δ.
A fit with a smaller MSE is always closer to the true film parameters.
A bare substrate inverts directly: ⟨ε⟩ = sin²φ·[1 + tan²φ·((1 − ρ)/(1 + ρ))²].
quiz.explanation: 裸基板可直接反演：⟨ε⟩ = sin²φ·[1 + tan²φ·((1 − ρ)/(1 + ρ))²]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A bare substrate inverts directly: ⟨ε⟩ = sin²φ·[1 + tan²φ·((1 − ρ)/(1 + ρ))²]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 橢偏量測的物理量與系統邊界：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ellipsometric observables and system boundaries: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「反射偏振比 ρ 與入射角」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Reflection ratio ρ and angle of incidence” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用一片剛去除原生氧化層的矽片（或以已知 1.5–2 nm 原生氧化層建模）在 60°、65°、70°、75° 四個角度量 Ψ、Δ，各自反演出 ⟨ε⟩；若四組 n、k 一致到小數第二位，表示入射角、偏光鏡方位與偵測器線性都正確，否則角度相依的差異會直接指出哪個元件有系統誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure Ψ and Δ on a silicon wafer with its native oxide freshly removed (or modelled as a known 1.5–2 nm layer) at 60°, 65°, 70° and 75° and invert each to ⟨ε⟩; if the four n, k pairs agree to the second decimal, angle of incidence, polarizer azimuth and detector linearity are all correct, otherwise the angle-dependent discrepancy points directly at the element carrying a systematic error. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把橢偏儀當反射率計使用、拿單一角度的強度訊號推薄膜厚度，光源 1% 的漂移就會變成奈米級厚度誤差；真正的橢偏量測必須建立在 Ψ、Δ 這兩個比值型觀測量之上。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Using the ellipsometer as a reflectometer and inferring thickness from single-angle intensity turns a 1% source drift into nanometre-scale thickness error; a genuine ellipsometric measurement must rest on the ratio-type observables Ψ and Δ.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用一片剛去除原生氧化層的矽片（或以已知 1.5–2 nm 原生氧化層建模）在 60°、65°、70°、75° 四個角度量 Ψ、Δ，各自反演出 ⟨ε⟩；若四組 n、k 一致到小數第二位，表示入射角、偏光鏡方位與偵測器線性都正確，否則角度相依的差異會直接指出哪個元件有系統誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Measure Ψ and Δ on a silicon wafer with its native oxide freshly removed (or modelled as a known 1.5–2 nm layer) at 60°, 65°, 70° and 75° and invert each to ⟨ε⟩; if the four n, k pairs agree to the second decimal, angle of incidence, polarizer azimuth and detector linearity are all correct, otherwise the angle-dependent discrepancy points directly at the element carrying a systematic error.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「橢偏量測的物理量與系統邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ellipsometric observables and system boundaries"?
options: 用一片剛去除原生氧化層的矽片（或以已知 1.5–2 nm 原生氧化層建模）在 60°、65°、70°、75° 四個角度量 Ψ、Δ，各自反演出 ⟨ε⟩。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
熔融石英視窗是等向性的，所以對橢偏量測完全透明無影響。
optionsEn: Measure Ψ and Δ on a silicon wafer with its native oxide freshly removed (or modelled as a known 1.5–2 nm layer) at 60°, 65°, 70° and 75° and invert each to ⟨ε⟩.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Fused-silica viewports are isotropic, so they are completely transparent to ellipsometric measurement.
quiz.explanation: 用一片剛去除原生氧化層的矽片（或以已知 1.5–2 nm 原生氧化層建模）在 60°、65°、70°、75° 四個角度量 Ψ、Δ，各自反演出 ⟨ε⟩；若四組 n、k 一致到小數第二位，表示入射角、偏光鏡方位與偵測器線性都正確，否則角度相依的差異會直接指出哪個元件有系統誤差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure Ψ and Δ on a silicon wafer with its native oxide freshly removed (or modelled as a known 1.5–2 nm layer) at 60°, 65°, 70° and 75° and invert each to ⟨ε⟩; if the four n, k pairs agree to the second decimal, angle of incidence, polarizer azimuth and detector linearity are all correct, otherwise the angle-dependent discrepancy points directly at the element carrying a systematic error. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 橢偏量測的物理量與系統邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ellipsometric observables and system boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反射偏振比 ρ 與入射角」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Reflection ratio ρ and angle of incidence” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把橢偏儀當反射率計使用、拿單一角度的強度訊號推薄膜厚度，光源 1% 的漂移就會變成奈米級厚度誤差；真正的橢偏量測必須建立在 Ψ、Δ 這兩個比值型觀測量之上。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Using the ellipsometer as a reflectometer and inferring thickness from single-angle intensity turns a 1% source drift into nanometre-scale thickness error; a genuine ellipsometric measurement must rest on the ratio-type observables Ψ and Δ. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：系統邊界是：一束已知偏振的準直光、一個角度已知的反射面、一個能解出偏振態的分析臂。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The system boundary is a collimated beam of known polarization, a reflecting surface at a known angle, and an analysis arm able to solve for the polarization state.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橢偏儀量的是反射光強度，所以光源越穩定厚度越準。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An ellipsometer measures reflected intensity, so a more stable source gives more accurate thickness." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把橢偏儀當反射率計使用、拿單一角度的強度訊號推薄膜厚度，光源 1% 的漂移就會變成奈米級厚度誤差；真正的橢偏量測必須建立在 Ψ、Δ 這兩個比值型觀測量之上。
knowledge.textEn: Using the ellipsometer as a reflectometer and inferring thickness from single-angle intensity turns a 1% source drift into nanometre-scale thickness error; a genuine ellipsometric measurement must rest on the ratio-type observables Ψ and Δ.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「橢偏量測的物理量與系統邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ellipsometric observables and system boundaries" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
把橢偏儀當反射率計使用、拿單一角度的強度訊號推薄膜厚度，光源 1% 的漂移就會變成奈米級厚度誤差；真正的橢偏量測必須建立在 Ψ、Δ 這兩個比值型觀測量之上。
Ψ 與 Δ 和厚度是一一對應的，所以一個波長就能唯一決定厚度。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Using the ellipsometer as a reflectometer and inferring thickness from single-angle intensity turns a 1% source drift into nanometre-scale thickness error.
Ψ and Δ map one-to-one to thickness, so a single wavelength determines it uniquely.
quiz.explanation: 把橢偏儀當反射率計使用、拿單一角度的強度訊號推薄膜厚度，光源 1% 的漂移就會變成奈米級厚度誤差；真正的橢偏量測必須建立在 Ψ、Δ 這兩個比值型觀測量之上。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using the ellipsometer as a reflectometer and inferring thickness from single-angle intensity turns a 1% source drift into nanometre-scale thickness error; a genuine ellipsometric measurement must rest on the ratio-type observables Ψ and Δ. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 菲涅耳係數、薄膜干涉與厚度靈敏度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Fresnel coefficients, thin-film interference and thickness sensitivity: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「SiO₂/Si 薄膜的菲涅耳—艾里模型」如何決定橢圓偏光儀建置的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fresnel–Airy model of SiO₂/Si films” determines the key performance of “Ellipsometer construction”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單層薄膜的反射係數由兩個界面的菲涅耳係數與膜內相位厚度 β = 2π(d/λ)·√(n₁² − sin²φ) 組成：r = (r₀₁ + r₁₂e^{−2iβ})/(1 + r₀₁r₁₂e^{−2iβ})，p 與 s 各算一次再取比值得到 ρ(d, n₁, n₂, φ, λ)。量測得到 Ψ、Δ 之後，厚度與折射率是以模型擬合反解，而不是直接讀出。對很薄的膜，Δ 對厚度的靈敏度極高而 Ψ 幾乎不動；膜厚增加到數十奈米後 Ψ 開始承擔厚度資訊；當 β 累積到 π 時 Ψ、Δ 回到起點，產生厚度週期性的多解。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SiO₂/Si 薄膜的菲涅耳—艾里模型」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A single film's reflection coefficient combines the Fresnel coefficients of its two interfaces with the film phase thickness β = 2π(d/λ)·√(n₁² − sin²φ): r = (r₀₁ + r₁₂e^{−2iβ})/(1 + r₀₁r₁₂e^{−2iβ}), evaluated for p and s and then ratioed to give ρ(d, n₁, n₂, φ, λ). Thickness and index are recovered by fitting this model to the measured Ψ and Δ, not read directly. For very thin films Δ is extremely sensitive to thickness while Ψ hardly moves; beyond a few tens of nanometres Ψ takes over the thickness information; and once β accumulates to π, Ψ and Δ return to their starting values, producing periodic thickness ambiguity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fresnel–Airy model of SiO₂/Si films”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：SiO₂（n₁ = 1.457）在 Si 上、φ = 70°、λ = 632.8 nm 的厚度週期為 d_p = λ/(2√(n₁² − sin²φ)) = 632.8/(2×1.1135) = 284 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For SiO₂ (n₁ = 1.457) on Si at φ = 70° and λ = 632.8 nm the thickness period is d_p = λ/(2√(n₁² − sin²φ)) = 632.8/(2×1.1135) = 284 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「Ψ 與 Δ 和厚度是一一對應的，所以一個波長就能唯一決定厚度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ψ and Δ map one-to-one to thickness, so a single wavelength determines it uniquely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「SiO₂/Si 薄膜的菲涅耳—艾里模型」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Fresnel–Airy model of SiO₂/Si films”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 菲涅耳係數、薄膜干涉與厚度靈敏度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fresnel coefficients, thin-film interference and thickness sensitivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「SiO₂/Si 薄膜的菲涅耳—艾里模型」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fresnel–Airy model of SiO₂/Si films” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：SiO₂（n₁ = 1.457）在 Si 上、φ = 70°、λ = 632.8 nm 的厚度週期為 d_p = λ/(2√(n₁² − sin²φ)) = 632.8/(2×1.1135) = 284 nm。由模型計算：d → 0 時 dΔ/dd = −2.86°/nm、dΨ/dd ≈ 0.014°/nm；d = 100 nm 時 Ψ = 41.06°、Δ = 79.79°，dΨ/dd = 0.55°/nm、dΔ/dd = 0.063°/nm。若儀器的 Ψ、Δ 解析度為 0.01°，原生氧化層的厚度解析度約 0.0035 nm，100 nm 膜約 0.02 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For SiO₂ (n₁ = 1.457) on Si at φ = 70° and λ = 632.8 nm the thickness period is d_p = λ/(2√(n₁² − sin²φ)) = 632.8/(2×1.1135) = 284 nm. The model gives dΔ/dd = −2.86°/nm and dΨ/dd ≈ 0.014°/nm as d → 0, while at d = 100 nm, Ψ = 41.06°, Δ = 79.79°, dΨ/dd = 0.55°/nm and dΔ/dd = 0.063°/nm. With 0.01° resolution in Ψ and Δ, the thickness resolution is about 0.0035 nm for a native oxide and about 0.02 nm for a 100 nm film. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：取一組熱氧化矽片（標稱 2、25、100、300 nm），在 70° 量 Ψ、Δ 並以單層模型擬合；把擬合值畫在 Ψ–Δ 軌跡圖上，確認它們落在模型曲線上且 300 nm 樣品落在第二週期；再把 100 nm 片在 65° 與 75° 重量，確認擬合厚度在 0.1 nm 內一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take a set of thermally oxidised wafers (nominal 2, 25, 100 and 300 nm), measure Ψ and Δ at 70° and fit a single-layer model; plot the results on the Ψ–Δ trajectory to confirm they lie on the model curve with the 300 nm sample in the second period, then remeasure the 100 nm wafer at 65° and 75° and confirm the fitted thickness agrees within 0.1 nm.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 菲涅耳係數、薄膜干涉與厚度靈敏度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fresnel coefficients, thin-film interference and thickness sensitivity: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「SiO₂/Si 薄膜的菲涅耳—艾里模型」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fresnel–Airy model of SiO₂/Si films” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 取一組熱氧化矽片（標稱 2、25、100、300 nm），在 70° 量 Ψ、Δ 並以單層模型擬合；把擬合值畫在 Ψ–Δ 軌跡圖上，確認它們落在模型曲線上且 300 nm 樣品落在第二週期；再把 100 nm 片在 65° 與 75° 重量，確認擬合厚度在 0.1 nm 內一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take a set of thermally oxidised wafers (nominal 2, 25, 100 and 300 nm), measure Ψ and Δ at 70° and fit a single-layer model; plot the results on the Ψ–Δ trajectory to confirm they lie on the model curve with the 300 nm sample in the second period, then remeasure the 100 nm wafer at 65° and 75° and confirm the fitted thickness agrees within 0.1 nm. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：單波長、單角度量測一片 384 nm 的氧化層，擬合報出 100 nm 且 MSE 極小，因為兩者相差剛好一個週期；沒有光譜或多角度資訊時這個錯誤無法從數據本身察覺。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A single-wavelength, single-angle measurement of a 384 nm oxide fits as 100 nm with a tiny MSE because the two differ by exactly one period; without spectroscopic or multi-angle data the error cannot be detected from the data themselves.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 菲涅耳係數、薄膜干涉與厚度靈敏度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fresnel coefficients, thin-film interference and thickness sensitivity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「SiO₂/Si 薄膜的菲涅耳—艾里模型」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instruction: 單波長、單角度量測一片 384 nm 的氧化層，擬合報出 100 nm 且 MSE 極小，因為兩者相差剛好一個週期；沒有光譜或多角度資訊時這個錯誤無法從數據本身察覺。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A single-wavelength, single-angle measurement of a 384 nm oxide fits as 100 nm with a tiny MSE because the two differ by exactly one period; without spectroscopic or multi-angle data the error cannot be detected from the data themselves. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對很薄的膜，Δ 對厚度的靈敏度極高而 Ψ 幾乎不動；膜厚增加到數十奈米後 Ψ 開始承擔厚度資訊；當 β 累積到 π 時 Ψ、Δ 回到起點，產生厚度週期性的多解。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For very thin films Δ is extremely sensitive to thickness while Ψ hardly moves; beyond a few tens of nanometres Ψ takes over the thickness information; and once β accumulates to π, Ψ and Δ return to their starting values, producing periodic thickness ambiguity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「Ψ 與 Δ 和厚度是一一對應的，所以一個波長就能唯一決定厚度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Ψ and Δ map one-to-one to thickness, so a single wavelength determines it uniquely." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 單波長、單角度量測一片 384 nm 的氧化層，擬合報出 100 nm 且 MSE 極小，因為兩者相差剛好一個週期；沒有光譜或多角度資訊時這個錯誤無法從數據本身察覺。
knowledge.textEn: A single-wavelength, single-angle measurement of a 384 nm oxide fits as 100 nm with a tiny MSE because the two differ by exactly one period; without spectroscopic or multi-angle data the error cannot be detected from the data themselves.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「菲涅耳係數、薄膜干涉與厚度靈敏度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fresnel coefficients, thin-film interference and thickness sensitivity" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
補償器只是讓訊號變大的選配件，旋轉檢偏鏡型儀器不需要它。
單波長、單角度量測一片 384 nm 的氧化層，擬合報出 100 nm 且 MSE 極小，因為兩者相差剛好一個週期。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
The compensator is an optional accessory to boost signal that a rotating-analyzer instrument never needs.
A single-wavelength, single-angle measurement of a 384 nm oxide fits as 100 nm with a tiny MSE because the two differ by exactly one period.
quiz.explanation: 單波長、單角度量測一片 384 nm 的氧化層，擬合報出 100 nm 且 MSE 極小，因為兩者相差剛好一個週期；沒有光譜或多角度資訊時這個錯誤無法從數據本身察覺。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A single-wavelength, single-angle measurement of a 384 nm oxide fits as 100 nm with a tiny MSE because the two differ by exactly one period; without spectroscopic or multi-angle data the error cannot be detected from the data themselves. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
